title: Using {product} at work: a 4-minute university research study
description: A research study by {team} at {institution} on how useful and easy to use people find {product} at work.
audience: Adults (18 or older) who have used {product} for work in the last 3 months
purpose: Test whether perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use predict intention to keep using {product} at work (Technology Acceptance Model constructs)

welcome.title: Using {product} at work: a research study
welcome.description:
We're {team} at {institution}, studying how people experience {product} at work. Your answers will help researchers and designers understand what makes workplace tools worth using.
• For adults who have used {product} for work in the last 3 months
• Takes about 4 minutes
• Anonymous: no names or contact details are collected
• Taking part is voluntary; you can stop at any time
• Approved by the {institution} ethics committee (ref. {ethics_ref})
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you for taking part
thank_you.description: Your answers have been recorded anonymously. A summary of the findings will be available from {contact} after the study closes on {date}. If you have concerns about this study, contact the {institution} ethics committee and quote ref. {ethics_ref}.

questions.label: I am 18 or older, I have read the study information above, and I agree to take part.
questions.description: What you'll do: answer about 11 short questions on your experience with {product}. Risks: none beyond everyday life. Your data: stored securely by {institution}, reported only in aggregate, kept for {retention}, then deleted. Because answers are anonymous, they cannot be withdrawn once submitted. You may stop at any point before submitting.

questions.label: Have you used {product} for work in the last 3 months?
In a typical week, how often do you use {product} for work?
Part 1: how useful {product} is
questions.description: For each statement, choose how much you agree or disagree. There are no right or wrong answers.

questions.label: How much do you agree or disagree with each statement about the usefulness of {product}?
rows: Using {product} helps me get my work done more quickly
Using {product} improves the quality of my work
Using {product} makes it easier to do my job
Overall, I find {product} useful in my job

questions.label: Overall, how satisfied or dissatisfied are you with {product}?
Part 2: how easy {product} is to use
How much do you agree or disagree with each statement about how easy {product} is to use?
rows: Learning to use {product} was easy for me
I find it easy to get {product} to do what I want
My interactions with {product} are clear and understandable
Overall, I find {product} easy to use

questions.label: Is there anything about using {product} at work that these statements did not capture?
How much do you agree or disagree with each statement about your plans for {product}?
rows: I intend to keep using {product} at work over the next 3 months
I expect to use {product} more often in the future
I plan to use {product} for more of my tasks

questions.label: Finally, a few questions about you
questions.description: These help us describe who took part. Every question is optional and answers are reported only in summary.

questions.label: How do you describe your gender?
How many years of work experience do you have?
